launchCalls.command:
mkdir -p evidence/scenarios && cat > evidence/run-scenario.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Deploy one clean copy of the built bundle, feed it a scenario input, export the audit, stop it.
# Usage: evidence/run-scenario.sh <ID> <input-file>
set -e
ID="$1"; INPUT="$2"
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
DEPLOY="$ROOT/evidence/scenarios/$ID/deploy"
rm -rf "$ROOT/evidence/scenarios/$ID"
mkdir -p "$DEPLOY/target" "$DEPLOY/data"
# fresh copy: jar (reused, never rebuilt), config, scripts. No audit/, no logs/, no output.txt.
cp "$ROOT/target/preview-smoke-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar" "$DEPLOY/target/"
cp -R "$ROOT/config" "$DEPLOY/config"
cp "$ROOT/run-server.sh" "$ROOT/export-audit.sh" "$ROOT/stop-server.sh" "$DEPLOY/"
cp "$INPUT" "$DEPLOY/data/input.txt"
OUT="$ROOT/evidence/scenarios/$ID"
( cd "$DEPLOY" && ./run-server.sh > "$OUT/server-stdout.log" 2>&1 ) &
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  sleep 1
  grep -q "PriceEvent" "$OUT/server-stdout.log" 2>/dev/null && break
done
sleep 3
( cd "$DEPLOY" && ./export-audit.sh > "$OUT/export.log" 2>&1 ) || echo "EXPORT FAILED rc=$?" >> "$OUT/export.log"
( cd "$DEPLOY" && ./stop-server.sh > "$OUT/stop.log" 2>&1 ) || echo "STOP FAILED rc=$?" >> "$OUT/stop.log"
wait || true
cp "$DEPLOY/logs/audit-preview-smoke.yaml" "$OUT/audit-$ID.yaml" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no audit yaml exported)" > "$OUT/audit-$ID.MISSING"
cp "$DEPLOY/data/output.txt" "$OUT/output-$ID.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no sink file produced)" > "$OUT/output-$ID.ABSENT"
echo "scenario $ID done"
EOF
chmod +x evidence/run-scenario.sh
# scenario inputs
cp data/input.txt evidence/input-A.txt
printf 'ACME,10.25,3\nACME,10.25,3\nBETA,20.5,7\n' > evidence/input-B.txt
printf 'ZERO,0,0\nNEG,-12.5,-4\nPOS,12.5,4\n' > evidence/input-C.txt
printf 'SMALL,0.125,1\nLARGE,1000000.25,2000000000\nTAIL,0.5,2\n' > evidence/input-D.txt
printf 'THIRD,3,30\nFIRST,1,10\nSECOND,2,20\n' > evidence/input-E.txt
printf 'ONLY,7.75,11\n' > evidence/input-F.txt
md5 data/input.txt config/server-config.yml src/main/fluxtion/designer/application-context.xml pom.xml > evidence/original-checksums.txt
cat evidence/original-checksums.txt
